name: 11363 · Douglaston, NY
findings: ZIP 11363 (Douglaston) has 39 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11363 (Douglaston) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
71% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 11363 (Douglaston) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).
